report.answer: The cache key is the SHA-256 of a canonical JSON record whose fields are query, backend, filters, time_bucket, backend_version, plus source_class and kind. Omitting any field is rejected. Changing any one field changes the key (live distinct_keys=8). time_bucket is a discrete token from the per-class TTL: when RES-0006 measured TTLs are absent, every class uses the worst-case default 'unmeasured:must-revalidate' (must-revalidate before cite; heuristic freshness refused). Resume reuses an unchanged origin (action=reuse) and refetches a mutated origin (action=refetch). A hash-mismatched cache body is never served. SUCCESS:RES-0171

report.strongest_surviving_counterargument: A time_bucket inside the identity key will miss after a bucket roll even if the page is unchanged, over-fetching; omitting it silently cites across TTL. This design keeps time_bucket in the key AND revalidates unmeasured classes, paying the over-fetch to avoid a stale cite. RES-0006, if later measured, narrows buckets without changing the field list.
